verdict.rationale: Requesty is an LLM gateway, and the evidence shows no product-level way for a user to define autonomous background automations, scheduled jobs, or recurring tasks. Automatic fallback retries and caching are internal routing behaviors rather than user-configured automations. Service accounts and the MCP gateway are building blocks an external agent could use, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
